en.t: The two of them went on exchanging words of love,

units.source_text: 那女子不知道我听得很生气，又弹起筝来了，

en.t: and the woman, unaware that listening to them had made me very angry, began playing the koto again,

units.source_text: 她用南吕调奏出流行的乐曲，虽然手法灵敏，不免有些刺耳。

en.t: playing a popular tune in the Nanryo mode; although her touch was nimble, it was still rather grating to the ear.
